result.stdout:
Usage: build [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Reconciles a canonical runtime bundle from a fixed-layout source bundle root.

Options:
  --root <string>                                        The root containing <c>bundle.json</c>, <c>definitions</c>, and generated output. [Default: @"skills"]
  --skill-bundle-version, --skillBundleVersion <int?>    The exact target bundle version. Omit it to preserve the version authored in bundle.json. [Default: null]
  --check                                                Whether to fail without writing when generated output requires changes.
